figurative_meaning_en: To assign or give someone a job or task
example_sentences_in_bangla: পিতা তার ছেলেকে একটি ভালো কাজ দেওয়ার ব্যবস্থা করেছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The company has given a job to the new employee.
The father has arranged a good job for his son.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of employment and task assignment in Bengali-speaking regions.
